title: Storey Architecture footer
description: A black footer: two columns of medium headings with small link lists (site index, legal), a contact block and the plain wordmark at the left; at the right a wide photo bleeding to the page edge with a small tilted paper note pinned over its corner. It rises 20vw into place as it arrives, and a 20vw strip below it holds a scene.
notes: drawn with bg-foreground: a black footer on light themes, a pale one on dark themes
the strip below shows the scene slot (the original lets its page-wide WebGL layer show through); empty shows a soft fade
place it last on the page
